media.stamp.cameraDenied.message.en: Allow the camera in Settings to take a stamp photo. We only use it when you tap the shutter.
media.stamp.cameraDenied.message.zh-Hans: 到“设置”里允许相机，就能拍邮票照片。只有你按下快门时才会拍照。

media.stamp.cameraIssue.en: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings, then try again.
media.stamp.cameraIssue.zh-Hans: 相机权限未开启，请在设置中开启后重试。

media.stamp.capturedPreview.zh-Hans: 实际拍摄并裁切为 4:5 的照片

media.stamp.createDormant.en: Saving stamps isn’t open yet. Your photo stays on this phone and nothing is uploaded.
media.stamp.createDormant.zh-Hans: 存入集邮册暂未开放，照片只留在本机，不会上传。

media.stamp.disabled.en: The camera can't be used here right now
media.stamp.disabled.zh-Hans: 暂时无法在这里使用相机

media.stamp.phase.awaitingCreate.zh-Hans: 照片已上传，点「完成存入」。

media.stamp.phase.unavailable.en: Safe recovery storage is unavailable. No upload or save can start.
media.stamp.phase.unavailable.zh-Hans: 安全恢复存储不可用，暂不能上传或入册。

media.stamp.purpose.en: Your photo is cropped to 4:5. You'll see it before it's saved to your album.
media.stamp.purpose.zh-Hans: 照片会裁成 4:5，存入集邮册前可以先看一眼。

roam.createdStamp.changed.en: The album account or session changed. Go back to continue.
roam.createdStamp.changed.zh-Hans: 集邮册账户或会话已变化，请返回后继续。

roam.experience.caption.zh-Hans: 写一句配文（最多 30 字）

roam.stamp.exchange.failed.en: The swap did not complete. Retrying is safe and will not duplicate your stamp.
roam.stamp.exchange.failed.zh-Hans: 交换没有完成。重试是安全的，不会重复投递你的印章。

roam.stamp.exchange.footer.en: Your stamp is shared anonymously. You can hide any stamp you receive from its detail page.
roam.stamp.exchange.footer.zh-Hans: 你的印章会匿名分享。收到的印章可在详情页中隐藏。
